function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the 2023 3CX DesktopApp software supply-chain compromise comprehensively using only authoritative public evidence that you return with explicit source IDs. Build a source-grounded chronology and evidence chain covering: (1) the earliest publicly documented access, execution, intrusion, or compromise activity and all uncertainty about the initial vector; (2) how malicious code or activity propagated through 3CX development, build, signing, release, and distribution processes; (3) how compromised DesktopApp versions reached customers, including only publicly documented payloads, mechanisms, indicators, and effects; and (4) public attribution of the threat activity, distinguishing confirmed facts, vendor or government assessments, allegations, competing attributions, and unresolved uncertainty. Prioritize primary sources such as 3CX statements, Mandiant/Google Cloud, Sophos, SentinelOne, Kaspersky, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, CISA or other government notices, incident reports, malware analyses, and court or regulatory records if relevant. For every material point, provide the exact returned source ID and quote or precisely summarize the evidence; identify publication dates, contradictions between sources, unsupported inferences, and gaps. Do not fill gaps with speculation. The final answer must be possible to write exclusively from the source IDs you return."}
function.name: ConductResearch
